rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for surrounding land or an area with a wall, fence, or similar boundary.

example.english: Enclose the garden so the dogs cannot get out.
example.traditional: 圍住個花園，唔畀啲狗走出去。
example.jyutping: wai4 zyu6 go3 faa1 jyun4 m4 bei2 di1 gau2 zau2 ceot1 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for the casual, physical act of putting something inside an envelope, package, or other container.

example.english: Please enclose the photo in the envelope.
example.jyutping: cing2 zoeng1 zoeng1 soeng2 fong3 jap6 go3 seon3 fung1

rows.note: Use this in formal written correspondence when enclosing an accompanying document or item with a letter.

example.english: I enclose a copy of the contract; please acknowledge receipt.
example.traditional: 現附上合約副本，請查收。
example.jyutping: jin6 fu6 soeng5 hap6 joek3 fu3 bun2 cing2 caa4 sau1
